record.notes: Simulated (MD, Onsager-coefficient) conductivity of lithium 4-(didodecylamino)naphthalene-1-sulfonate, not an experimental measurement. The minus sign in the exponent and the superscript were lost in PDF extraction; the value is written as 6.4 x 10^-4 S/cm in the original. The experimental conductivities appear only in Fig. 3(b) with no numbers in the text, and the other compositions' values appear only in figures, so no further records were made.
